en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ayyub b. Nuh. He said: I heard Aba Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa (as) say:

Whoever visits the grave of my father (as) in Tus, Allah will forgive his past and future sins. On the Day of Resurrection, a pulpit will be installed for him near the pulpit of the Messenger of Allah (s), until Allah finishes judging His servants.
